quarterly_data.signal: Fiscal year to March 2026 (annual securities report, IFRS): revenue JPY 7,539,975 million (105.3% of the prior year) on higher vehicle sales; operating profit JPY 5,525 hundred million (+6.5%) as rationalization and better utilization offset US tariffs, higher material costs and investment in people; profit attributable to owners of the parent JPY 4,438 hundred million (+5.9%). Segment sales (JPY million): Japan 3,087,881 (105.8%), North America 2,012,358 (108.9%), Europe 691,545 (107.0%), Asia 1,622,176 (99.5%); segment operating profit: Japan JPY 1,859 hundred million (-15.7%), North America 1,323 (+34.9%), Europe 278 (+221.3%), Asia 1,788 (+5.5%). Production (at selling prices) JPY 7,622,181 million (105.3%); all production is made to customers' quarterly production plans.
quarterly_data.figure: FY to March 2026 revenue JPY 7,539,975 million (+5.3%); operating profit JPY 5,525 hundred million (+6.5%)

quarterly_data.signal: Customer Toyota Motor (annual securities report): sales to Toyota Motor Corporation were JPY 1,991,604 million, 26.4% of FY2026 sales (prior year JPY 1,902,231 million, 26.6%); the Toyota group, its main customer group, accounts for about half of sales, with revenue from it of JPY 4,134,582 million in FY2026 (JPY 3,903,121 million the prior year) across all segments.
quarterly_data.figure: Toyota Motor JPY 1,991,604 million, 26.4% of FY2026 sales; Toyota group JPY 4,134,582 million

quarterly_data.signal: Plans (annual securities report): DENSO announced its 'CORE 2030' medium-term plan on March 31, 2026, with three growth pillars - stronger products for diversifying mobility (semiconductor performance, materials, energy management and high-reliability ADAS systems), manufacturing innovation fusing shop-floor know-how with AI, and people and partner co-creation (including FA, agriculture and semiconductors); it tracks revenue, operating profit and ROE. Capex was JPY 369,267 million in FY2026 (Japan 228,765 million) and the plan for the following year is JPY 400,000 million (Japan 266,200 million, North America 57,300 million, Asia 57,000 million, Europe 11,800 million) for production expansion, next-generation models and new-product changeovers.
quarterly_data.figure: capex plan JPY 400,000 million for the next year (FY2026 actual JPY 369,267 million)

quarterly_data.signal: R&D (annual securities report): group R&D spending was JPY 690,073 million in FY2026 (about 88% in Japan). In October 2025 DENSO developed a new inverter, a cell-voltage monitoring circuit and a shunt current sensor adopted in Toyota Motor's new bZ4X; the inverter, mounted in the new eAxle of BluE Nexus (its electric-drive joint venture with Aisin), uses DENSO's own SiC power semiconductors and double-sided cooling to cut power loss by about 70% and shrink the core module by about 30%; it also developed what it calls the world's first 28-channel cell-voltage monitoring IC. It is developing a gas-based SiC crystal-growth method targeting about 15 times the productivity of sublimation and about 90% lower energy use and CO2, and a SiC device with its own 3D structure, pursuing vertically integrated development from wafer to inverter. It developed a 'Knowledge Graph Agent' for AI-driven software development and is building the Zenmyo-minami new plant in Nishio, Aichi as a smart factory using AI agents and physical AI. In July 2025 it acquired all shares of Axia Group B.V. (Axia Vegetable Seeds) to accelerate its agriculture business.
quarterly_data.figure: R&D JPY 690,073 million; SiC inverter power loss -~70%, core module ~30% smaller
